title: SpireLab — 魔女 / The Witch
description:
[h1]魔女 / The Witch[/h1]
原创魔女。每场战斗可选择一张临时奖励牌，并用魔法启迪交换牌堆中的实际卡牌。91 种卡牌、9 件遗物、3 种药水，含简体中文与英文。

An original playable Witch with Fate Selection and Arcane Insight. Includes 91 cards, 9 relics, 3 potions, and English and Simplified Chinese support.

[b]Requires BaseLib 3.4.8 or later.[/b] Target game v0.111.1.
changeNote: v1.6.0 · Fate Selection, real pile exchange, revised cards and live combat status icons.
